$comment: Which packages this viewer reads, and where they are. One entry per project.
`root` is resolved against the viewer directory, so "../ticvai" is the
package beside it. The viewer and the packages are separate repositories
checked out side by side; neither contains the other.
An absolute path works too — a package does not have to be near the viewer.
`id` is the first segment of every read: /pkg/<id>/index. Lowercase, hyphens,
no dots or slashes. `default` answers the pre-project /api/* routes.
Read once at startup; adding a project is a restart.

projects.name: TICVAI
projects.note: The venue platform delivery package — the one this viewer was written for.
